MSSP

Managed Security Service Provider

operationsmedium

An MSSP is a vendor that operates security services for clients, such as monitoring firewalls, managing SIEM platforms, and watching alerts around the clock. Smaller organizations use MSSPs to get enterprise-grade security operations without building their own SOC. It matters because the security talent shortage means many companies simply cannot hire enough skilled defenders in-house.
